verdict.rationale: Clerk documents a vendor-maintained, open-source migration tool that ingests a JSON/CSV list of users and creates them via the Backend API, explicitly for migrating off other providers (clerk-docs-7, clerk-supp-migration-tool). However, the evidence never confirms the tool imports existing password hashes or otherwise avoids forcing users to reset passwords — a key part of this story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of password/credential hash migration support, guidance on preserving existing sessions, and independent/hands-on confirmation that migrated users are not forced to reset passwords.
